about_the_game:
Dive into an enthralling adventure as James, an ordinary man whose life takes an extraordinary turn. After a whirlwind digital romance with Maria, she mysteriously vanishes from his life as quickly as she appeared. All that remains is a single photograph, a beautiful image hinting at a secluded Russian village. Driven by an unshakeable connection and a desperate need for answers, James embarks on an epic journey to Donki Hills, a remote community near Novosibirsk, to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance.

1-Hour Narrative Experience: Immerse yourself in a focused and impactful story, designed to be completed in a single, engaging session.

  • Atmospheric Woodland Setting: Explore the serene yet mysterious woods of Donki Hills, brought to life with detailed environments and a captivating ambiance.

  • Walking Simulator Gameplay: Progress through the narrative by exploring the environment, uncovering clues, and experiencing the unfolding story at your own pace.

  • Enigmatic Storytelling: Piece together the mystery of Maria's disappearance through environmental storytelling, subtle clues, and fragmented narratives.

  • Original Soundtrack: A hauntingly beautiful musical score accompanies your journey, enhancing the emotional depth and atmospheric tension of the game.

Embark on a concise yet profound journey into the heart of a mystery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Modern Core i5 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 3010 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Modern Core i7 or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 3080 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible

short_description: Ordinary guy James searches for missing Maria, his online match. His only clue: a photo from the mysterious Russian village of Donki Hills. Embark on a dangerous journey to unravel her disappearance and uncover a truth that could change everything.
